answer: Every claim climbs the karst of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the summit re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The garden of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
